decisions: Cases store viewport and closure metadata; saveViewport preserves updatedAt so shelf ordering does not churn on pan/zoom.
Card and connection writes update the owning case's updatedAt in the same transaction.
Connections use both a globally unique pairKey index and a unique [caseId+pairKey] compound index.
Attachment writes verify the owning card in the same transaction and reject duplicate kinds in one set.
Stored-row validation failures surface as StorageReadError with the underlying DomainValidationError as cause.

payload.taskDescription: Create a Dexie v1 database with cases, cards, connections, and attachments tables and the indexes needed by the shelf and board: cases by updatedAt and examDate, cards by caseId and caseId+type, connections by caseId and a unique pairKey, attachments by cardId and cardId+kind. Implement mappers between persisted rows and domain records, a CaseRepository for case and card CRUD and case summaries with card and connection counts, and an AttachmentStore for original/display/thumbnail Blobs. Preserve isDemo, backupPromptedAt, tags, OCR fields when present, viewport, and closure metadata. Use one read-write transaction per mutation, validate on read and write, and expose an in-memory fake for tests. Do not import React, fetch, or feature modules.
